scope: Synthesis of packet doctrine from NYC, Chicago, Seattle, San Francisco, Austin, Mesa, and the live V2 city-incident builder/validator path.

central_source_gate.meaning: Central config is the coarse source-level allowlist. If it is not ready_now, the live builder will not consider the city.

packet_gate.meaning: Packet status is the operational promotion switch. Central ready_now alone is not enough.

offense_selective_gate.meaning: Offense-selective promotion is real repo behavior, not just packet prose.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Name the exact live public feed contract before any mapping work.
required_evidence: whether old local loader assumptions are stale
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: Austin and Seattle both show that stale loader assumptions cause false blockers or false confidence.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Record the exact raw snapshot or query path used for review.
required_evidence: local cache path if one exists
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: San Francisco and NYC depend on dual-feed discipline; Seattle and Chicago depend on stable cache contracts.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Prove the live contract still supports V2 offense/date/spatial logic across the target years.
required_evidence: null-rate or field-loss notes for offense and spatial fields
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: Austin's null-heavy offense schema and Seattle's dropped proxy geography are gating failures, not minor notes.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Create the offense crosswalk and the dedupe rule together.
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: San Francisco required incident_number plus V2 offense dedupe and initial-only gating; Austin required bounded code-candidate isolation; Seattle mapped cleanly from NIBRS codes.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Show how rows become in-city block-group incidents and how redacted or invalid rows are handled.
required_evidence: treatment of out-of-city or OOJ rows
public proxy fallback if coordinates are missing or redacted
whether proxy geography survives into the cache used by the builder
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: Seattle became viable only after Beat-aware fallback. San Francisco remains partially blocked because privacy-snapped and Out of SF rows cannot all be allocated.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Compare final or promotable counts to an official or defensible public reference and classify each line as exact or approximate.
required_evidence: final count vs published count by offense
written explanation for every material gap
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: Unexplained divergence is either a bug, a concept mismatch, or a promotion blocker.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: Translate evidence into packet-local promotion status.
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: Seattle shows offense-selective should be explicit. SF shows promising offenses do not justify city-wide promotion.

standard_sequence_of_work.objective: State what central configs should say after packet review, but keep packet-local status more precise than central config.
required_evidence: whether central recommended_disposition should stay ready_now, needs_schema_work, or insufficient_quality
whether packet source_candidate is now stale relative to packet findings
what builder support is still missing
standard_sequence_of_work.why_it_matters: Central config is coarse. Packet status carries the true operational state until sync.

minimum_evidence: all retained core offenses have defendable mappings
spatial assignment is solved for the retained city-wide contract
no material unexplained exact-comparable gap remains
promoted offenses have defendable evidence individually
blocked offenses are explicitly marked no or blocked
current live contract is not yet translated safely into V2 logic
material gaps appear intrinsic to the public product or unresolved hardening limits
city or offense cannot be promoted under the current contract

interpretation_notes: Chicago is the cleanest city-wide bar: exact-comparable lines land roughly within 0 to 3 percent.
Seattle and Austin show that roughly 3 to 6 percent exact-comparable gaps can still support offense-selective promotion when the logic is explicit and the remaining issue is understood.
San Francisco shows that roughly 8 to 9 percent exact-comparable gaps are watchlist territory even after hardening and should not justify city-wide promotion.
Austin murder, Seattle aggravated_assault, and San Francisco murder and rape show that exact-comparable gaps above about 10 percent are blockers unless a legacy exception is already live.
NYC is a live legacy packet and should not be treated as the future default threshold template because several exact-comparable lines remain materially off while the packet stays active.

packet_local_files_should_store: city-specific blockers and minimum changes to unblock
central_vs_packet_interaction.practical_rule: Do not use central configs as the only truth. Use central configs to queue and coarse-gate; use packet_status and packet_offense_status to decide what actually ships.

observed_patterns.pattern: Central ready_now plus packet partial plus offense_selective is a valid live configuration.
Central insufficient_quality plus packet blocked can still carry offense-selective candidate evidence for future repo support.
Central needs_schema_work plus packet-specific bounded refresh status is the right shape for a near-term schema refresh city.

highly_reusable: source contract lock before loader work
dedupe plus crosswalk as a paired step
separate exact versus approximate comparability labels
explicit treatment of redacted rows and out-of-city rows
central ready_now plus packet status handshake
reconciliation_summary.csv as the promotion evidence table
city_specific: dual-feed cutoff dates and overlap logic
official published comparator source and labels
proxy geography choice such as beat, block group field, or none
privacy redaction semantics and acceptable residual tail

city_case_summaries.main_takeaway: Useful for packet shape and dual-feed sourcing, but not the clean promotion threshold template.
Best city-wide pattern: stable single feed, direct coordinates, mature crosswalk, exact-comparable reconciliation.
Best proof that retained proxy geography can recover privacy-redacted incidents and justify offense-selective promotion.
Best proof that good hardening on several offenses still does not justify city-wide promotion when murder and rape remain public-feed limited.
Best proof that needs_schema_work can be a narrow loader-refresh task rather than a full rebuild.
Useful reminder that second-wave cities can remain scaffolded until first-wave blockers are resolved.

top_doctrine_candidates: Central ready_now is necessary but not sufficient; packet_status is the operational gate and packet_offense_status is mandatory for offense-selective build.
Do not promote from raw geocode share alone. Validate in-city membership, redaction recovery, and whether proxy geography survives into the actual builder cache.
Use exact-comparable offense lines as the hard gate. Approximate lines can support offense-selective judgment but should not independently unlock city-wide promotion.
Treat bounded empirical refresh rules as blocked until they are validated across multiple periods and written into the packet contract.
Keep central configs coarse and packet-local statuses precise. The packet is where city-specific truth should live until sync.
